entities.name: Gruffudd ap Gwenwynwyn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gruffudd ap Gwenwynwyn was a Welsh king who was lord of the part of Powys known as Powys Wenwynwyn; he sided with King Edward I of England in the latter's conquest of Wales of 1277–1283.
